summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, and the package export in monai/losses/__init__.py. Added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with six parameterized cases covering the binary 2D and empty-class scenarios (correct, flipped, and channel-variant targets). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and acceptance numbers are unverified; the batch-coupling, numpy equivalence, max-normalization, non-square error, and reduction-invariance cases are not covered by tests. No commits made.
